title: EC2
body:
Here's a comprehensive guide on AWS EC2 Cost Optimization — covering the top strategies and best practices for 2025:

💰 AWS EC2 Cost Optimization — Best Practices

1. 🔍 Right-Size Your Instances

  • Use AWS Compute Optimizer (ML-powered) to analyze usage patterns and recommend the best-fit instance types, including Graviton-based instances
  • Regularly review and adjust EC2, Auto Scaling, and EBS resources
  • Eliminate over-provisioned instances to avoid paying for unused compute

2. 📝 Smart Commitment Management

  • Savings Plans or Reserved Instances (RIs) offer up to 75% discount for committed usage
  • Start with flexible 1-year, no upfront plans; transition to 3-year, all-upfront for stable workloads
  • Share unused RIs across accounts or resell them on the RI Marketplace
  • Use AWS Cost Explorer's AI-powered recommendations for optimal Savings Plan selection

3. ⚡ Leverage Spot Instances

  • Save up to 90% vs. On-Demand pricing for fault-tolerant/flexible workloads
  • Ideal for: batch processing, CI/CD pipelines, big data jobs, ML training
  • Automate Spot instance allocation using Auto Scaling Groups

4. 🗄️ Optimize Storage & Data Transfer

  • Migrate from gp2 → gp3 EBS volumes (cheaper + better performance)
  • Detach and delete unused volumes
  • Monitor outbound data transfer costs — leverage CloudFront or S3 Transfer Acceleration where appropriate

5. 🚀 Modernize with Graviton Processors

  • AWS Graviton instances deliver up to 40% better price-performance than comparable x86 instances
  • Migrate compatible workloads to Graviton for significant cost-per-compute savings
  • Consider Flex Instances for under-utilized applications

6. 🕐 Scheduling & Automation

  • Use AWS Instance Scheduler to run EC2 instances only during business hours
  • Automate start/stop policies for dev/test environments (can save 60–70% on non-prod)
  • Deploy real-time observability platforms (e.g., Sedai) for autonomous self-tuning

7. 🏷️ Tagging & Resource Reviews

  • Tag all resources by team, project, or environment to track costs accurately
  • Use AWS Trusted Advisor and Cost Explorer for monthly reviews
  • Promptly shut down idle or zombie instances

8. 💡 Pricing Model Mix Strategy

Workload TypeRecommended Model
Predictable, steady-stateReserved Instances / Savings Plans
Variable, spikyOn-Demand
Fault-tolerant, flexibleSpot Instances
Dev/Test environmentsScheduled On-Demand

9. 🌐 Multi-Account & Multi-Region Optimization

  • Use AWS Organizations for consolidated billing to share savings across accounts
  • Compare pricing across AWS regions — costs vary significantly by region

10. 📊 Adopt FinOps Practices

  • Treat cloud cost as a shared responsibility between engineering and finance
  • Run regular optimization review cycles (monthly recommended)
  • Use AI-driven modeling for proactive spend forecasting

  • ProsperOps - EC2 Cost Optimization
  • AWS Learning Zone - EC2 Pricing & Optimization Tips
  • Sedai - Understanding Amazon EC2
